AVIATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #3
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

----

   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development.

   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development.

8. When learning Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.

9. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Run with the tool

10. When learning Aircraft Basic Maintenance, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Overload every socket

13. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. Speaker
   C. CPU
   D. Keyboard
